Echoes of Change#640.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#641.src: More to the point... YOU. Cursed. You just keep summing to your list of crimes! There's the Torann massacre, we can add every other soldier to the tally... And...the death of a Sovereign.
Echoes of Change#641.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#642.src: Let me ask. Do you know how it feels to die? Disposed of like yesterday's garbage? Do you know how exponentially more excruciating it is to feel IN REVERSE?!
Echoes of Change#642.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#643.src: If dealing with you quickly wasn't magnitudes of order more important, I'd give you a lesson on the topic. Consider yourself lucky, cursed!
Echoes of Change#643.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#644.src: What... what's going to happen with Syndra?
Echoes of Change#644.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#645.src: ...an attempt on Her Majesty's life carries high consequences. Almost positive she'll be divided out...but that isn't my problem to solve.
Echoes of Change#645.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#646.src: Weren't you... weren't you friends?! And you're just, going to let-
Echoes of Change#646.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#647.src: NOT ONE MORE FACTORING WORD! How much do you think I enjoy this?! Do you think I want to hunt her down like a forgotten variable?!
Echoes of Change#647.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#648.src: She chose to terminate our sequence! She threw that all away, used me for some irrational solution! She has as much value as any of you zeroes now!
Echoes of Change#648.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#649.src: So why don't we accelerate this? Without that traitor misusing her blessing... Your number's up!!
Echoes of Change#649.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#651.src: I... I think I'm gonna be sick...
Echoes of Change#651.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#652.src: He's... he's dead. Again. We beat him... again.
Echoes of Change#652.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#653.src: Again?! So he was being literal about you killing him before?
Echoes of Change#653.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#654.src: ... Okay. Okay, so... probably not down for good. Great! That's just... great.
Echoes of Change#654.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#656.src: I... I don't, um, have enough mana left to fight, anymore... s-so we should leave, before-
Echoes of Change#656.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#657.src: Uh... y- yeah, we should... get moving.
Echoes of Change#657.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#659.src: H- how...? It, it took him way longer, last time...
Echoes of Change#659.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#660.src: Nngh... You...miscalculated! I told you! You know how good I am at crunching the numbers! I prepared...hhhff...for this possibility!
Echoes of Change#660.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#661.src: It was a calculated risk. Overloading the old Nasin charm... That could've broken it. But instead...my expected solution is here!
Echoes of Change#661.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#662.src: A near-instant revival! And I heard your collaborator- All out of power now. I nearly had you in round one, even. Fight all you want- it'll sum to nothing, murderer!
Echoes of Change#662.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#664.src: ...Soosu. Thank you for taking me seriously. I didn't want you involved for the danger, but with both of us... We'll solve this problem in no time. Follow my le-
Echoes of Change#664.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#665.src: GAAAH!! S-SOOSU?! You... What was...?! Nnh...
Echoes of Change#665.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#666.src: Soosu!! Th-These are the insurgents! The murderers!! You can't be- What did they- WHAT ARE YOU HOLDING OVER HER?! Soosu, I swear, you can get out of-
Echoes of Change#666.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#667.src: Yeah, yeah... I know. But I think I'm sick and tired of trying.
Echoes of Change#667.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#668.src: ...Soosu...you can't- I know you can be better, you can- I'll-
Echoes of Change#668.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#669.src: It'll all be over soon, Z. Please... don't make me kill you again.
Echoes of Change#669.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#671.src: Why- why are you helping us?
Echoes of Change#671.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#672.src: Just... go, Yus. You're wasting time.
Echoes of Change#672.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#673.src: But... I was the one who stole your project. Why would you...
Echoes of Change#673.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#674.src: Yes, Yus, I know! What does it matter why I'm helping you? Just... just take it and go. Before they realize you're here.
Echoes of Change#674.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#676.src: Ugh, why are you so-! Fine! You - when I look at you, it's like I'm looking at myself, before... before I became this.
Echoes of Change#676.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#677.src: Now, go! Run! Flee! Just, leave!
Echoes of Change#677.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#678.src: If... If I leave you here. You, you-
Echoes of Change#678.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#679.src: I'll be okay, Yusanu, I'm tired of fighting. I'm tired of my duty. I'm sick of this life.
Echoes of Change#679.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#681.src: We... we need to go, Yusanu.
Echoes of Change#681.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#683.src: Well then, Syndra the Lioness. Nothing to say in response? Has a cat got your tongue?
Echoes of Change#683.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#684.src: I have no words for you.
Echoes of Change#684.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#685.src: No, I suppose you were always more fond of the language of violence...
Echoes of Change#685.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#686.src: You'll notice the area has been cleared. You understand what this means for you, yes?
Echoes of Change#686.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#687.src: The same as always. I kill you, or I die trying.
Echoes of Change#687.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#688.src: Yuman... We n- n- need to find an escape route that w- wor- works!
Echoes of Change#688.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#689.src: Ugh, there are way more guards than we expected! We'll have to find a way to dodge them all...
Echoes of Change#689.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#691.src: I ca- ca- can't stand this... not h- hel- helping Syndra!
Echoes of Change#691.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#692.src: Hey, man, have faith. She'll find a way out of there! But for now, we've gotta worry 'bout ourselves, 'kay?
Echoes of Change#692.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#693.src: Yeah... th- thanks, Yuman. Let's k- ke- keep moving.
Echoes of Change#693.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#694.src: Behold, citizens... the face of the insurgent group.
Echoes of Change#694.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#695.src: The two cursed ones who attacked us have been captured. However, there are still people out there who wish us harm. Please, stay on high alert!
Echoes of Change#695.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#696.src: If you notice any suspicious behaviour, contact your local military. Together, we will prevail as a nation.
Echoes of Change#696.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#697.src: But do not worry. Even such an aggressive assault from the enemy stood no chance against our might. I will ensure everyone's safety!
Echoes of Change#697.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#698.src: Now. As punishment for attempting to assassinate me... I will execute Syndra, leader of the cursed terrorists, right here!
Echoes of Change#698.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#699.src: Her accomplice will be imprisoned and questioned for information on the remaining insurgents.
Echoes of Change#699.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#702.src: I don't regret anything I've done. I know Fruma will change for the better. Maybe not today, or tomorrow! But change will come.
Echoes of Change#702.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#703.src: I regret that it had to come to this, Syndra... I draw no joy from your death. I wonder, whatever happened to that woman who held boundless potential within?
Echoes of Change#703.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#705.src: I will find your children, Syndra. This tantrum of yours ends here with you.
Echoes of Change#705.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#706.src: Now, as for those Sovereigns of mine...
Echoes of Change#706.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#707.src: I know you, Soosu. Please, tell me what's wrong! This isn't an unsolvable problem! Don't make it so I lose two of my-
Echoes of Change#707.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#708.src: Sovereign Zhiraok. I cannot help but notice the obvious lack of captured terrorists, amidst the scene of a battle.
Echoes of Change#708.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#709.src: Your Majesty!! The insurgents, they must have blackmailed Sovereign Soosu, she-
Echoes of Change#709.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#710.src: Silence. You have failed me twice, now. They have bested you in combat twice, Sovereign.
Echoes of Change#710.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#711.src: I- The cursed have greater cunning than I cal-
Echoes of Change#711.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#712.src: I am disappointed in your performance. You are now expressly forbidden from continuing to chase and track down these... rotten children.
Echoes of Change#712.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#713.src: ...I. ... ...I alone take full responsibility for this failure, Your Majesty. Bu-
Echoes of Change#713.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#714.src: Focus yourself on maintaining {p} operations in the absence of its Sovereign, would you? You have much experience already, I'm sure.
Echoes of Change#714.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#716.src: Now, stop standing there, and do something! Rally the soldiers, track down the remnants of that terrorist group still hiding!
Echoes of Change#716.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#719.src: As for you... do you think your little games will spare you from my wrath? Attacking a fellow Sovereign, allowing these targets to escape...
Echoes of Change#719.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#720.src: Bla, bla, whatever. Just get it over with. Kill me already, if I'm so worthless to you.
Echoes of Change#720.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#721.src: And allow you a peaceful death? After I gave you everything, and you turned around and betrayed me?!
Echoes of Change#721.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#722.src: No, Soosu. You deserve no such mercy from me.
Echoes of Change#722.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#723.src: ...every last factoring person down here is charged with conspiracy. Her Majesty demands their capture, by any and all means.
Echoes of Change#723.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#724.src: Get it done. Now. One of them must know what they did to Soo- ... I'll be questioning each of them. Personally.
Echoes of Change#724.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok
